# Warmup animation tuning. Installed as Win64\t7ghost\warmup\tuning.txt; Ctrl+F9 rereads it.
# <Character>[_<Round1|Up|Down|Final>]  blend=<frames>  cut=<frames>  cutstart=<frames>  pin=1
#   blend = how many final frames ease into the idle pose (default 24 = 0.4 s at 60 fps)
#   cut   = frames dropped from the end first, then the blend runs on the new end
#           (default 20 for everyone, 30 for Jin - built into the mod; cut=0 = the whole animation)
#   cutstart = frames dropped from the START (body and hands); 30 frames always stay
#   pin      = 1 keeps the fighter on its spot: no sideways / forward body movement (height, crouches and
#              hops stay); pin=0 lets it move again
#   travel   = <percent>: how far the fighter moves sideways / forward, measured from its own spot (where
#              pin keeps it): 100 = as the animation does (default), 50 = half as far, 0 = like pin=1, up to 200.
#              The path keeps its shape and still ends where the animation ends; pin=1 wins over travel
# A line for one animation wins over the character's line, and any line wins over the defaults.
# Several lines for one name add up (e.g. one line blend=, another cut=).
# Borrowed animations (batch.py COPIES) use the borrowing character's name: Julia_Down, Katarina_Round1, ...
# Names as the animation files: LuckyChloe, Kazumi, MasterRaven, DevilJin, Jack7, ArmorKing, ...
Jin blend=24   # author 2026-11-15: back to the normal 0.4 s (was 48)
MasterRaven blend=30
MasterRaven cut=30

Kazumi_Round1 blend=80

Kazumi_Down blend=50

# Lifebar fade-in (Warmup Cinematic Angles): frames of "Round N ... Fight!" at 60 fps - LifebarFade = round 1,
# LifebarFadeRounds = every other round (one shared timing). The lifebars are
# invisible until frame <start> and fully visible from frame <end> (linear in between). Ctrl+F9 rereads it.
LifebarFade start=45 end=80   # author 2026-11-15 (also the built-in default)
LifebarFadeRounds start=25 end=40   # rounds 2+ (author 2026-11-16; also the built-in default)
# More screen elements fading with the lifebars: LifebarFadeExtra <movie>:<clip> (several allowed). Movies:
# SW_UI_HUD_Assist, SW_UI_HUD_ControlGuide, SW_UI_HUD (e.g. SW_UI_HUD:_root - but that includes the faded top part).
# (the P1 / P2 / YOU / CPU markers are not Flash - they fade with the lifebars automatically since 2026-11-16)

# Hand reach (converter setting for tools/warmup/convert_native.py, not read by the game - re-convert after changing it):
# <Name>_<Sit>_HandIK until=<frame> fade=<frames> amount=<%> up=<cm> forward=<cm> spread=<cm> [target=<bone>]
#   hands pulled to the target bone (default L_Foot = left ankle) at full strength until frame (until - fade),
#   fading out by frame `until`; up / forward / spread = where they touch (cm), spread = distance between the hands
Julia_Final_HandIK until=65 fade=20 amount=40 up=-10 forward=-15 spread=-20
